errors.text_span: Категориите са подредени във възходящ ред спрямо процентните стойности
errors.evidence: The description claims that the categories are sorted in ascending order according to their percentage values, but they are not sorted. The values are presented in the following order from top to bottom: 14.1%, 53.7%, 16.1%, 10.1%, 28.9%, 15.4%, 20.8%, 6.0%.
